name: PawSharp
description: A .NET 8+ Discord API wrapper providing a REST client with 140+ endpoints, a WebSocket gateway for 40+ real-time events, built-in caching, slash command interactions, and automatic sharding.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
PawSharp is a .NET 8+ Discord API wrapper built around clean abstractions and a dependency-injection-first design. Rather than bundling everything into a single assembly, it is split into focused NuGet packages so you only take on what you actually need.

Package List

PackagePurpose
PawSharp.CoreBase entities, enums, and exceptions shared by all packages
PawSharp.APIREST client with 140+ Discord API endpoints
PawSharp.GatewayWebSocket gateway and real-time event dispatcher (40+ events)
PawSharp.CacheIn-memory and Redis caching providers
PawSharp.ClientUnified entry-point that wires REST, Gateway, and Cache together
PawSharp.CommandsPrefix-based command framework with module support
PawSharp.InteractionsSlash commands and other application command types
PawSharp.InteractivityReaction menus, pagination, and component helpers
PawSharp.VoiceVoice channel support (experimental)

REST API Coverage

CategoryCoverage
MessagesFull — send, edit, delete, bulk-delete, pin, reactions, typing
ChannelsFull — all channel types, invites, webhooks, threads
GuildsFull — CRUD, audit logs, scheduled events, auto-moderation
Members & UsersFull — member management, role assignment, bans, kicks
RolesFull — CRUD, permission management, assignment
Slash CommandsFull — global and guild-scoped application commands
InteractionsFull — responses, follow-ups, modals
WebhooksFull — create, execute, manage
ThreadsFull — create, archive, membership
VoicePartial (experimental)
i
Alpha notice PawSharp is currently in pre-release. Public APIs may change between alpha releases. Pin your package versions when building against an alpha build.

sections.title: Installation
sections.content:
Prerequisites

  • .NET 8.0 SDK or later — download from dotnet.microsoft.com
  • A Discord bot token — create an application at the Discord Developer Portal
  • Basic familiarity with C# and async/await

Recommended Setup

For most bots, install the unified client bundle along with the command and interaction packages:

dotnet add package PawSharp.Client
dotnet add package PawSharp.Commands
dotnet add package PawSharp.Interactions
dotnet add package Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.Console

Minimal / Component Setup

If you only need specific functionality, install individual packages:

# REST API only (no gateway events)
dotnet add package PawSharp.API

# Gateway only (no REST)
dotnet add package PawSharp.Gateway

# Caching (included in PawSharp.Client)
dotnet add package PawSharp.Cache

# Redis distributed cache (requires StackExchange.Redis)
dotnet add package PawSharp.Cache
dotnet add package StackExchange.Redis
i
Version pinning During the alpha phase, minor version bumps may include breaking changes. Use an exact version constraint in your .csproj: <PackageReference Include="PawSharp.Client" Version="0.6.0-alpha1" />

sections.title: Quickstart
sections.content:
The following example creates a fully working bot that responds to a prefix command. It demonstrates service registration, event subscription, and graceful shutdown.

using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Logging;
using PawSharp.Client;
using PawSharp.Core.Enums;
using PawSharp.Gateway.Events;

// 1. Configure services
var services = new ServiceCollection()
    .AddLogging(b => b.AddConsole())
    .AddSingleton(new PawSharpOptions
    {
        Token   = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DISCORD_TOKEN")
                  ?? throw new InvalidOperationException("DISCORD_TOKEN is not set"),
        Intents = GatewayIntents.AllUnprivileged | GatewayIntents.MessageContent,
        ApiVersion = 10,
    })
    .AddPawSharp();

// 2. Resolve the client
var provider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
var client   = provider.GetRequiredService<DiscordClient>();

// 3. Subscribe to events before connecting
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(ready =>
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Connected as {ready.User.Username}#{ready.User.Discriminator}");
    Console.WriteLine($"Guilds: {ready.Guilds.Count}");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    if (msg.Author.IsBot) return;

    if (msg.Content == "!ping")
    {
        await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, new()
        {
            Content = "Pong!",
        });
    }
});

// 4. Connect and block until Ctrl+C
using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();
Console.CancelKeyPress += async (_, e) =>
{
    e.Cancel = true;
    Console.WriteLine("Shutting down...");
    await client.DisconnectAsync();
    cts.Cancel();
};

await client.ConnectAsync();
Console.WriteLine("Bot is running. Press Ctrl+C to stop.");
await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cts.Token);

Set your token as an environment variable before running:

# Windows PowerShell
$env:DISCORD_TOKEN = "your_token_here"
dotnet run

# Linux / macOS
export DISCORD_TOKEN=your_token_here
dotnet run

sections.title: Configuration
sections.content:
PawSharpOptions

All configuration is provided through a single PawSharpOptions object registered in the DI container.

var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    // Required
    Token      = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DISCORD_TOKEN")!,
    ApiVersion = 10,

    // Gateway - specify only the intents your bot uses
    Intents = GatewayIntents.AllUnprivileged | GatewayIntents.MessageContent,

    // Sharding - Discord requires sharding for bots in 2500+ guilds
    Shards       = ShardingStrategy.Auto,  // Calculate automatically
    TotalShards  = 4,                      // Override when using manual sharding
    ShardId      = 0,                      // Which shard this instance owns

    // Reconnection strategy
    ReconnectTimeout     = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1),
    MaxReconnectAttempts = 5,

    // Cache limits
    CacheSettings = new CacheSettings
    {
        MaxCachedGuilds           = 1_000,
        MaxCachedChannelsPerGuild = 100,
        MaxCachedMessages         = 10_000,
        MessageCacheTTL           = TimeSpan.FromHours(1),
    },
};

PawSharpOptions Reference

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
TokenstringRequiredBot token from the Discord Developer Portal. Never hard-code this value — read it from an environment variable or secret manager.
ApiVersionint10Discord REST and Gateway API version. Use 10 unless you have a specific reason to change it.
IntentsGatewayIntentsRequiredBit-field of gateway events your bot will receive. See GatewayIntents Flags below.
ShardsShardingStrategyNoneAuto lets Discord calculate the required shard count; Manual requires you to set TotalShards and ShardId yourself.
TotalShardsint?nullTotal number of shards. Required when Shards is ShardingStrategy.Manual.
ShardIdint?nullZero-based index of the shard this process handles. Required when Shards is ShardingStrategy.Manual.
ReconnectTimeoutTimeSpan1 sDelay before the first reconnect attempt after an unexpected gateway disconnect.
MaxReconnectAttemptsint5Maximum consecutive reconnect attempts before the client stops retrying and throws.
CacheSettingsCacheSettingsdefaultsCapacity and TTL limits for the built-in in-memory cache. See CacheSettings Reference below.

CacheSettings Reference

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
MaxCachedGuildsint1,000Maximum number of guild objects held in memory at one time.
MaxCachedChannelsPerGuildint100Maximum channels stored per guild.
MaxCachedMessagesint10,000Maximum message objects held in memory across all channels combined.
MessageCacheTTLTimeSpan1 hourHow long a cached message is retained before automatic eviction.

GatewayIntents Flags

Request only the intents your bot actually uses. Discord restricts event delivery to the intents you declare at connection time. Privileged intents must also be enabled in the Discord Developer Portal under Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents.

FlagPrivilegedEvents Enabled
GuildsNoGuild create/update/delete; channel, role, and thread lifecycle events
GuildMembersYesGuildMemberAddEvent, GuildMemberUpdateEvent, GuildMemberRemoveEvent
GuildBansNoGuildBanAddEvent, GuildBanRemoveEvent
GuildEmojisNoEmoji and sticker update events
GuildIntegrationsNoIntegration create/update/delete events
GuildWebhooksNoWebhook update events
GuildInvitesNoInvite create and delete events
GuildVoiceStatesNoVoiceStateUpdateEvent
GuildPresencesYesPresenceUpdateEvent
GuildMessagesNoMessageCreateEvent, MessageUpdateEvent, MessageDeleteEvent in guild channels
GuildMessageReactionsNoReaction add/remove/clear events in guild channels
GuildMessageTypingNoTypingStartEvent in guild channels
DirectMessagesNoMessage create/update/delete events in DMs
DirectMessageReactionsNoReaction events in DMs
DirectMessageTypingNoTypingStartEvent in DMs
MessageContentYesPopulates Content, Embeds, Attachments, and Components on messages. Without this, those fields are empty strings or empty arrays.
GuildScheduledEventsNoScheduled event create/update/delete/user events
AutoModerationConfigurationNoAutoMod rule create/update/delete events
AllUnprivileged—Convenience combination of all non-privileged flags above
// Standard setup for most bots
var intents = GatewayIntents.AllUnprivileged
    | GatewayIntents.MessageContent;

// Narrow scope — only guild structure and messages
var intents = GatewayIntents.Guilds
    | GatewayIntents.GuildMessages
    | GatewayIntents.DirectMessages;
!
Privileged intents MessageContent, GuildMembers, and GuildPresences are privileged. They must be enabled in the Discord Developer Portal under Bot → Privileged Gateway Intents before your bot can request them.

Dependency Injection

Register PawSharp with the AddPawSharp() extension method. Pass an optional cache provider to override the default in-memory store.

// Default in-memory cache
services
    .AddSingleton(options)
    .AddPawSharp();

// Explicit in-memory provider
services
    .AddSingleton(options)
    .AddPawSharp(cache: new MemoryCacheProvider());

// Redis distributed cache
services
    .AddSingleton(options)
    .AddPawSharp(cache: new RedisCacheProvider("localhost:6379"));

var client = services
    .BuildServiceProvider()
    .GetRequiredService<DiscordClient>();

sections.title: Core Concepts
sections.content:
DiscordClient

The DiscordClient is the central object you resolve from the DI container. It provides access to every subsystem.

var client = provider.GetRequiredService<DiscordClient>();

var rest         = client.Rest;          // IDiscordRestClient - 140+ endpoints
var gateway      = client.Gateway;       // IGatewayClient - WebSocket + dispatcher
var cache        = client.Cache;         // IEntityCache - in-memory or Redis
var interactions = client.Interactions;  // IInteractionsClient - slash commands

DiscordClient Subsystems

PropertyTypeDescription
RestIDiscordRestClient140+ HTTP endpoints — send messages, manage guilds, roles, channels, and more
GatewayIGatewayClientWebSocket connection and typed event dispatcher (40+ events). Access the dispatcher via Gateway.EventDispatcher.
CacheIEntityCacheIn-memory or Redis entity store, populated automatically from gateway events. Lookups are synchronous and sub-millisecond.
InteractionsIInteractionsClientSlash command registration and interaction response helpers
CurrentUserUserThe bot's own User object. Available after ConnectAsync() completes.

REST vs Gateway

Understanding when to use each subsystem is fundamental to working with Discord's API.

TaskSubsystem
Send or edit a messageclient.Rest
Create or delete a channelclient.Rest
Ban or kick a memberclient.Rest
Fetch guild or user data on demandclient.Rest
React to a new incoming messageclient.Gateway.EventDispatcher
React when a member joins or leavesclient.Gateway.EventDispatcher
React to role or channel changesclient.Gateway.EventDispatcher

Entity IDs (Snowflakes)

All Discord entity IDs are 64-bit unsigned integers known as snowflakes. Always use ulong — never strings.

ulong guildId   = 1234567890123456789;
ulong channelId = 9876543210987654321;
ulong userId    = 1111111111111111111;

// Snowflakes encode a creation timestamp
// Discord epoch: 2015-01-01
var createdAt = DateTimeOffset.FromUnixTimeMilliseconds(
    (long)((guildId >> 22) + 1420070400000UL));
Console.WriteLine($"Guild created: {createdAt:yyyy-MM-dd}");

Async/Await Throughout

Every I/O operation in PawSharp is asynchronous. Blocking on async code with .Result or .Wait() risks thread-pool starvation and deadlocks. Always await.

// Correct pattern
var message = await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
await ProcessMessageAsync(message);

// Also correct for event handlers
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    var channel = await client.Rest.GetChannelAsync(msg.ChannelId);
    Console.WriteLine($"Received message in #{channel?.Name}");
});

// Avoid: blocks the thread and can cause deadlocks
var guild = client.Rest.GetGuildAsync(guildId).Result;   // BAD

sections.title: REST API — Messages
sections.content:
Sending Messages

CreateMessageRequest Properties

At least one of Content, Embeds, StickerIds, Components, or Files must be provided per message.

PropertyTypeRequiredDescription
Contentstring?See noteMessage text. Max 2,000 characters.
EmbedsList<Embed>?See noteUp to 10 rich embed objects. All embeds on a message must not exceed 6,000 characters combined.
Ttsbool?NoSends the message as text-to-speech. Requires the SEND_TTS_MESSAGES permission.
AllowedMentionsAllowedMentions?NoControls which @mentions in Content actually trigger notifications.
MessageReferenceMessageReference?NoSet MessageId to send this as a reply. Requires READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY.
ComponentsList<MessageComponent>?See noteInteractive components (buttons, select menus). Max 5 action rows per message.
StickerIdsList<ulong>?See noteIDs of up to 3 server stickers to attach.
i
Required permissions Sending to a guild channel requires SEND_MESSAGES. Using Tts = true additionally requires SEND_TTS_MESSAGES. Creating a reply requires READ_MESSAGE_HISTORY.
// Plain text
await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, new CreateMessageRequest
{
    Content = "Hello from PawSharp.",
});

// With embed
var embed = new Embed
{
    Title       = "Server Report",
    Description = "Daily activity summary.",
    Color       = 0x3498DB,
    Fields = new List<EmbedField>
    {
        new() { Name = "Messages", Value = "1,234", Inline = true },
        new() { Name = "Members",  Value = "567",   Inline = true },
        new() { Name = "Joins",    Value = "12",    Inline = true },
    },
    Footer    = new EmbedFooter { Text = "Generated at" },
    Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
};

await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, new CreateMessageRequest
{
    Content = "Here is today's summary:",
    Embeds  = new List<Embed> { embed },
});

// Multiple embeds (up to 10 per message)
await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, new CreateMessageRequest
{
    Embeds = new List<Embed> { embed1, embed2, embed3 },
});

Rich Embeds

Embed Properties

PropertyTypeLimitDescription
Titlestring?256 charsBold title text at the top of the embed. Becomes a hyperlink when Url is set.
Descriptionstring?4,096 charsMain body text. Supports Discord markdown.
Urlstring?—URL the title links to.
Colorint?—Decimal RGB integer for the left border colour (e.g. 0x3498DB = blue).
TimestampDateTime?—ISO 8601 timestamp shown beside the footer.
AuthorEmbedAuthor?Name: 256 charsSmall author block above the title. Properties: Name (required), Url, IconUrl.
ThumbnailEmbedImage?—Small image pinned to the top-right corner. Set the Url property.
ImageEmbedImage?—Full-width image below the body. Set Url; optionally set Width and Height.
FieldsList<EmbedField>?25 fields; Name 256, Value 1,024 chars eachNamed value rows. Set Inline = true on adjacent fields to display them side-by-side.
FooterEmbedFooter?Text: 2,048 charsFooter row at the bottom. Properties: Text (required), IconUrl.
i
6,000-character budget The combined total of all Title, Description, Field.Name, Field.Value, Footer.Text, and Author.Name values across every embed in a single message must not exceed 6,000 characters. Discord returns a 400 error if this limit is violated.
var richEmbed = new Embed
{
    Title       = "Full Embed Example",
    Description = "Demonstrates all embed fields.",
    Url         = "https://example.com",
    Color       = 0xFF5733,
    Timestamp   = DateTime.UtcNow,

    Author = new EmbedAuthor
    {
        Name    = "Author Name",
        Url     = "https://example.com/author",
        IconUrl = "https://example.com/author/icon.png",
    },

    Thumbnail = new EmbedImage { Url = "https://example.com/thumb.png" },

    Image = new EmbedImage
    {
        Url    = "https://example.com/banner.png",
        Width  = 1280,
        Height = 720,
    },

    Fields = new List<EmbedField>
    {
        new() { Name = "Full-width field", Value = "Takes the full row.",   Inline = false },
        new() { Name = "Left column",      Value = "Side by side.",         Inline = true  },
        new() { Name = "Right column",     Value = "Also side by side.",    Inline = true  },
    },

    Footer = new EmbedFooter
    {
        Text    = "Footer text",
        IconUrl = "https://example.com/footer-icon.png",
    },
};

Retrieving Messages

// Most recent 50 messages in a channel
var messages = await client.Rest.GetChannelMessagesAsync(channelId, limit: 50);

foreach (var msg in messages)
    Console.WriteLine($"{msg.Author.Username}: {msg.Content}");

// Paginate backwards through history
var older = await client.Rest.GetChannelMessagesAsync(
    channelId,
    limit:  50,
    before: messages.Last().Id   // Fetch messages older than the last one
);

// Fetch a specific message by ID
var single = await client.Rest.GetMessageAsync(channelId, messageId);

// Pinned messages
var pinned = await client.Rest.GetPinnedMessagesAsync(channelId);

Editing and Deleting

// Edit content
await client.Rest.EditMessageAsync(channelId, messageId, new EditMessageRequest
{
    Content = "Updated content.",
});

// Replace embeds
await client.Rest.EditMessageAsync(channelId, messageId, new EditMessageRequest
{
    Embeds = new List<Embed> { updatedEmbed },
});

// Delete a single message
await client.Rest.DeleteMessageAsync(channelId, messageId);

// Bulk delete (2 to 100 messages, must be under 14 days old)
var recentIds = messages.Take(25).Select(m => m.Id).ToList();
if (recentIds.Count >= 2)
    await client.Rest.BulkDeleteMessagesAsync(channelId, recentIds);
!
BulkDeleteMessagesAsync requires the MANAGE_MESSAGES permission. Messages older than 14 days cannot be bulk-deleted and will cause a 400 error. The count must be between 2 and 100 inclusive.

Pins and Typing

// Pin a message
await client.Rest.PinMessageAsync(channelId, messageId);

// Unpin a message
await client.Rest.UnpinMessageAsync(channelId, messageId);

// Show the "Bot is typing..." indicator for ~10 seconds
await client.Rest.TriggerTypingIndicatorAsync(channelId);

Reactions

// Add a reaction (Unicode emoji as name string)
await client.Rest.CreateReactionAsync(channelId, messageId, "thumbsup");

// Add a custom emoji reaction (format: name:id)
await client.Rest.CreateReactionAsync(channelId, messageId, "customemoji:123456789");

// Remove the bot's own reaction
await client.Rest.DeleteOwnReactionAsync(channelId, messageId, "thumbsup");

// Remove another user's reaction (requires Manage Messages)
await client.Rest.DeleteUserReactionAsync(channelId, messageId, "thumbsup", userId);

// Remove all reactions for a specific emoji
await client.Rest.DeleteAllReactionsForEmojiAsync(channelId, messageId, "thumbsup");

// Get users who reacted
var reactors = await client.Rest.GetReactionsAsync(channelId, messageId, "thumbsup");
foreach (var user in reactors)
    Console.WriteLine($"{user.Username} reacted");
i
Emoji format Unicode emoji must be passed by name (e.g. "thumbsup"). Custom emoji must use the name:id format (e.g. "customemoji:123456789"). The string must be URL-encoded before it is sent — PawSharp handles this automatically. Removing another user's reaction requires MANAGE_MESSAGES.

sections.title: REST API — Guilds & Channels
sections.content:
Getting Guild Information

// Basic guild info
var guild = await client.Rest.GetGuildAsync(guildId);
Console.WriteLine($"{guild.Name} — {guild.MemberCount} members");
Console.WriteLine($"Created: {guild.CreatedAt:yyyy-MM-dd}");
Console.WriteLine($"Owner:   {guild.OwnerId}");

// With approximate counts
var guildDetails = await client.Rest.GetGuildAsync(guildId, withCounts: true);
Console.WriteLine($"Approximate members: {guildDetails.ApproximateMemberCount}");

Managing Members

ModifyGuildMemberRequest Properties

PropertyTypeDescription
Nicknamestring?New guild display name. Pass an empty string to clear the current nickname.
RoleIdsList<ulong>?Complete replacement list of role IDs. Replaces all current roles — include existing roles you want to keep.
Mutebool?Server-mutes the member in voice channels. Requires MUTE_MEMBERS.
Deafenbool?Server-deafens the member in voice channels. Requires DEAFEN_MEMBERS.
ChannelIdulong?Move the member to a different voice channel. Set null to disconnect from voice.
!
Role hierarchy You can only assign or remove roles that are below your bot's highest role. Kick and ban actions also require the target's highest role to be below the bot's highest role. Discord returns HTTP 403 if this constraint is violated.
// Retrieve a single member
var member = await client.Rest.GetGuildMemberAsync(guildId, userId);
Console.WriteLine($"{member.User.Username} joined {member.JoinedAt}");
Console.WriteLine($"Roles: {string.Join(", ", member.RoleIds)}");

// List members (max 1000 per request)
var members = await client.Rest.GetGuildMembersAsync(guildId, limit: 1000);
foreach (var m in members)
    Console.WriteLine($"{m.User.Username}#{m.User.Discriminator}");

// Modify a member
await client.Rest.ModifyGuildMemberAsync(guildId, userId, new ModifyGuildMemberRequest
{
    Nickname = "Community Helper",
    RoleIds  = new List<ulong> { helperRoleId },
    Mute     = false,
    Deafen   = false,
});

// Kick a member
await client.Rest.RemoveGuildMemberAsync(guildId, userId, reason: "Violated server rules");

// Ban a member (delete last 7 days of messages)
await client.Rest.CreateGuildBanAsync(guildId, userId, deleteMessageDays: 7, reason: "Spam");

// Unban
await client.Rest.RemoveGuildBanAsync(guildId, userId);

// List current bans
var bans = await client.Rest.GetGuildBansAsync(guildId);
foreach (var ban in bans)
    Console.WriteLine($"{ban.User.Username} - {ban.Reason}");

Channels

// Get channel details
var channel = await client.Rest.GetChannelAsync(channelId);
Console.WriteLine($"#{channel.Name} (type: {channel.Type})");

// List all channels in a guild
var channels = await client.Rest.GetGuildChannelsAsync(guildId);
var textChannels = channels.Where(c => c.Type == ChannelType.GuildText);

// Create a text channel inside a category
var newChannel = await client.Rest.CreateGuildChannelAsync(guildId, new CreateChannelRequest
{
    Name     = "announcements",
    Type     = ChannelType.GuildText,
    Topic    = "Official server announcements.",
    ParentId = categoryId,
    Nsfw     = false,
});

// Create a voice channel
var voiceChannel = await client.Rest.CreateGuildChannelAsync(guildId, new CreateChannelRequest
{
    Name      = "General Voice",
    Type      = ChannelType.GuildVoice,
    Bitrate   = 64_000,
    UserLimit = 10,
});

// Edit a channel
await client.Rest.ModifyChannelAsync(channelId, new ModifyChannelRequest
{
    Name     = "important-announcements",
    Topic    = "Read-only announcements.",
    Position = 0,
});

// Delete a channel
await client.Rest.DeleteChannelAsync(channelId);

Invites

// Create a single-use invite expiring in one hour
var invite = await client.Rest.CreateChannelInviteAsync(channelId, new CreateInviteRequest
{
    MaxUses   = 1,
    MaxAge    = 3600,
    Temporary = false,
});
Console.WriteLine($"discord.gg/{invite.Code}");

// List invites for a channel
var invites = await client.Rest.GetChannelInvitesAsync(channelId);
foreach (var inv in invites)
    Console.WriteLine($"{inv.Code} - {inv.Uses}/{inv.MaxUses} uses");

Audit Logs

// Get recent audit log entries
var log = await client.Rest.GetGuildAuditLogsAsync(guildId, limit: 50);
foreach (var entry in log.AuditLogEntries)
    Console.WriteLine($"{entry.ActionType} by user {entry.UserId}: {entry.Reason}");

// Filter to ban actions only
var banLog = await client.Rest.GetGuildAuditLogsAsync(
    guildId,
    actionType: AuditLogEvent.MemberBanAdd,
    limit: 10
);

// Filter by a specific moderator
var modLog = await client.Rest.GetGuildAuditLogsAsync(
    guildId,
    userId: moderatorId,
    limit: 50
);

sections.title: REST API — Roles, Webhooks & Threads
sections.content:
Roles

CreateRoleRequest Properties

PropertyTypeDefaultDescription
Namestring?"new role"Display name of the role.
Colorint?0Decimal RGB colour (e.g. 0x3498DB). 0 renders as the default grey.
Hoistbool?falseWhether to display this role separately in the member list sidebar.
Mentionablebool?falseWhether any member can @mention this role.
Permissionslong?guild defaultPermissions bit-field. 0 grants no permissions beyond the guild defaults.
Positionint?lowInitial position in the role hierarchy. Higher values appear higher in the list.
i
Required permissions Creating, editing, and deleting roles requires MANAGE_ROLES. You can only manage roles that are positioned below your bot's highest role.
// List guild roles
var roles = await client.Rest.GetGuildRolesAsync(guildId);
foreach (var role in roles.OrderByDescending(r => r.Position))
    Console.WriteLine($"@{role.Name} (position {role.Position})");

// Create a role
var newRole = await client.Rest.CreateGuildRoleAsync(guildId, new CreateRoleRequest
{
    Name        = "Moderator",
    Color       = 0x3498DB,   // Blue
    Hoist       = true,       // Show separately in the member list
    Mentionable = true,
    Permissions = 0,
});

// Edit a role
await client.Rest.ModifyGuildRoleAsync(guildId, roleId, new ModifyRoleRequest
{
    Name  = "Senior Moderator",
    Color = 0x27AE60,   // Green
});

// Assign a role to a member
await client.Rest.AddGuildMemberRoleAsync(guildId, userId, roleId);

// Remove a role from a member
await client.Rest.RemoveGuildMemberRoleAsync(guildId, userId, roleId);

// Assign multiple roles at once (replaces all current roles)
await client.Rest.ModifyGuildMemberAsync(guildId, userId, new ModifyGuildMemberRequest
{
    RoleIds = new List<ulong> { roleId1, roleId2, roleId3 },
});

// Delete a role
await client.Rest.DeleteGuildRoleAsync(guildId, roleId);

Webhooks

// Create a static webhook for a channel
var webhook = await client.Rest.CreateWebhookAsync(channelId, new CreateWebhookRequest
{
    Name = "Status Updates",
});
Console.WriteLine($"Webhook ID: {webhook.Id}");

// Send a message through the webhook
await client.Rest.ExecuteWebhookAsync(webhook.Id, webhook.Token, new ExecuteWebhookRequest
{
    Content  = "Deployment finished successfully.",
    Username = "CI Bot",
    Embeds   = new List<Embed>
    {
        new()
        {
            Title       = "Build #142",
            Description = "All tests passed.",
            Color       = 0x2ECC71,
        },
    },
});

// List webhooks for a channel
var webhooks = await client.Rest.GetChannelWebhooksAsync(channelId);

// Modify a webhook
await client.Rest.ModifyWebhookAsync(webhook.Id, new ModifyWebhookRequest
{
    Name = "Deployment Bot",
});

// Delete a webhook
await client.Rest.DeleteWebhookAsync(webhook.Id);

Threads

// Start a thread from an existing message
var thread = await client.Rest.CreateThreadFromMessageAsync(
    channelId,
    messageId,
    new CreateThreadRequest
    {
        Name                = "Feedback: Feature Request",
        AutoArchiveDuration = 1440,   // Archive after 24 hours of inactivity
    }
);

// Create a standalone thread (forum-style)
var forumThread = await client.Rest.CreateThreadAsync(channelId, new CreateThreadRequest
{
    Name                = "Bug Report #123",
    AutoArchiveDuration = 4320,   // 3 days
});

// Thread membership
await client.Rest.JoinThreadAsync(thread.Id);
await client.Rest.AddThreadMemberAsync(thread.Id, userId);
await client.Rest.LeaveThreadAsync(thread.Id);
await client.Rest.RemoveThreadMemberAsync(thread.Id, userId);

// List active threads in a guild
var activeThreads = await client.Rest.GetActiveThreadsAsync(guildId);

// List archived public threads
var archived = await client.Rest.GetPublicArchivedThreadsAsync(channelId);

sections.title: Gateway & Events
sections.content:
How the Event Dispatcher Works

When the gateway receives a real-time event from Discord it deserializes it into a typed event object and passes it to all registered handlers. Handlers are invoked in subscription order. Use dispatcher.Use() for middleware that runs before every handler.

var dispatcher = client.Gateway.EventDispatcher;

// Subscribe with a lambda
dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(msg =>
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{msg.Author.Username}: {msg.Content}");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Subscribe with a named method
dispatcher.On<GuildMemberAddEvent>(OnMemberJoinedAsync);

private async Task OnMemberJoinedAsync(GuildMemberAddEvent e)
{
    await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(welcomeChannelId, new()
    {
        Content = $"Welcome to the server, {e.User.Username}!",
    });
}

Middleware

Middleware functions run before every event handler. Use them for logging, error catching, and filtering.

// Structured logging for every event
dispatcher.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    _logger.LogDebug("Event received: {EventType}", ctx.GetType().Name);
    await next();
});

// Global error boundary
dispatcher.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    try
    {
        await next();
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled error in event handler for {EventType}",
            ctx.GetType().Name);
    }
});

// Ignore all events from bots
dispatcher.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    if (ctx is MessageCreateEvent msg && msg.Author.IsBot)
        return;
    await next();
});

Event Reference

PawSharp surfaces 40+ Discord gateway events, grouped by category:

CategoryEvents
ConnectionReadyEvent, ResumedEvent
MessagesMessageCreateEvent, MessageUpdateEvent, MessageDeleteEvent, MessageDeleteBulkEvent
GuildsGuildCreateEvent, GuildUpdateEvent, GuildDeleteEvent
MembersGuildMemberAddEvent, GuildMemberUpdateEvent, GuildMemberRemoveEvent
ChannelsChannelCreateEvent, ChannelUpdateEvent, ChannelDeleteEvent, ChannelPinsUpdateEvent
RolesGuildRoleCreateEvent, GuildRoleUpdateEvent, GuildRoleDeleteEvent
ReactionsMessageReactionAddEvent, MessageReactionRemoveEvent, MessageReactionRemoveAllEvent
ThreadsThreadCreateEvent, ThreadUpdateEvent, ThreadDeleteEvent, ThreadMembersUpdateEvent
InteractionsInteractionCreateEvent
VoiceVoiceStateUpdateEvent, VoiceServerUpdateEvent
PresencePresenceUpdateEvent
TypingTypingStartEvent
BansGuildBanAddEvent, GuildBanRemoveEvent

Event Payload Reference

Key properties on the most frequently used event types. All events are typed classes delivered by client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.

ReadyEvent

PropertyTypeDescription
VintGateway protocol version negotiated with Discord
UserUserThe bot's own user object
GuildsIReadOnlyList<UnavailableGuild>All guilds the bot belongs to at startup — each is unavailable until the corresponding GuildCreateEvent fires
SessionIdstringOpaque session ID used internally for session resumption after a network drop
Shardint[]?[shardId, totalShards] when sharding is active; otherwise null

MessageCreateEvent

PropertyTypeDescription
IdulongMessage snowflake ID
ChannelIdulongChannel the message was posted in
GuildIdulong?Guild the message belongs to. null in DMs.
AuthorUserMessage author. Check Author.IsBot to skip messages from other bots.
ContentstringMessage text. Empty string unless the MessageContent privileged intent is active.
TimestampDateTimeOffsetWhen the message was sent (UTC)
EmbedsIReadOnlyList<Embed>Attached rich-content embed objects
AttachmentsIReadOnlyList<Attachment>Attached files
TypeMessageTypeMessage type: Default, Reply, ApplicationCommand, etc.

GuildMemberAddEvent

PropertyTypeDescription
GuildIdulongGuild the member joined
UserUserThe joined user object
Nicknamestring?Guild-specific display name, if already set at join time
RoleIdsIReadOnlyList<ulong>IDs of roles assigned to this member
JoinedAtDateTimeOffsetTimestamp of when the member joined the guild
IsMutedboolWhether the member is server-muted in voice channels
IsDeafenedboolWhether the member is server-deafened in voice channels

InteractionCreateEvent

PropertyTypeDescription
IdulongUnique interaction snowflake ID
ApplicationIdulongYour bot's application ID
TypeInteractionTypeApplicationCommand, MessageComponent, ModalSubmit, or ApplicationCommandAutocomplete
TokenstringInteraction token for sending and editing responses. Valid for 15 minutes.
DataInteractionData?Command name, selected options, and resolved objects. Present on ApplicationCommand-type interactions.
GuildIdulong?Guild where the interaction occurred. null for DM interactions.
ChannelIdulong?Channel where the interaction occurred
MemberGuildMember?Guild member who triggered the interaction. null in DMs.

Common Event Handlers

// Connection events
dispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(ready =>
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Connected as {ready.User.Username}. Guilds: {ready.Guilds.Count}");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

dispatcher.On<ResumedEvent>(_ =>
{
    Console.WriteLine("Gateway session resumed after reconnect.");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Member join/leave
dispatcher.On<GuildMemberAddEvent>(async member =>
{
    _logger.LogInformation("{User} joined guild {GuildId}",
        member.User.Username, member.GuildId);
});

dispatcher.On<GuildMemberRemoveEvent>(member =>
{
    _logger.LogInformation("{User} left guild {GuildId}",
        member.User.Username, member.GuildId);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Reaction events
dispatcher.On<MessageReactionAddEvent>(reaction =>
{
    Console.WriteLine($"{reaction.Member.User.Username} reacted with {reaction.Emoji.Name}");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Voice state changes
dispatcher.On<VoiceStateUpdateEvent>(state =>
{
    if (state.VoiceState.ChannelId.HasValue)
        Console.WriteLine($"{state.VoiceState.Member.User.Username} joined voice");
    else
        Console.WriteLine($"{state.VoiceState.Member.User.Username} left voice");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

Connection Management

// Connect to the gateway
await client.ConnectAsync();

// Disconnect gracefully
await client.DisconnectAsync();

// Check current state and reconnect manually if needed
if (!client.Gateway.IsConnected)
    await client.Gateway.ConnectAsync();

// PawSharp reconnects automatically on unexpected disconnects.
// Subscribe to ReadyEvent to be notified when the session is re-established.

Sharded Gateway

Discord requires bots in 2,500+ guilds to use sharding. Each shard maintains a separate WebSocket connection and receives events only for guilds assigned to it.

// Auto-sharding: Discord calculates the shard count
var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    Token  = token,
    Shards = ShardingStrategy.Auto,
};

services.AddSingleton(options).AddPawSharp();

var shardManager = provider.GetRequiredService<ShardManager>();
await shardManager.ConnectAllAsync();

// Events are dispatched across all shards automatically
dispatcher.On<GuildCreateEvent>(guild =>
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Shard received guild: {guild.Name}");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Inspect individual shard status
foreach (var (shardId, status) in shardManager.GetAllShardStatuses())
    Console.WriteLine($"Shard {shardId}: {status}");

sections.title: Commands
sections.content:
Prefix Commands

The PawSharp.Commands package provides an attribute-based command framework. Create a class that inherits BaseCommandModule and decorate methods with [Command].

using PawSharp.Commands;
using PawSharp.Commands.Attributes;
using PawSharp.Core.Models;

public class ModerationCommands : BaseCommandModule
{
    private readonly IDiscordRestClient _rest;
    private readonly ILogger<ModerationCommands> _logger;

    public ModerationCommands(IDiscordRestClient rest, ILogger<ModerationCommands> logger)
    {
        _rest   = rest;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    [Command("kick")]
    [Description("Remove a member from the server.")]
    public async Task KickAsync(CommandContext ctx, ulong userId,
        [Remainder] string reason = "No reason provided")
    {
        await _rest.RemoveGuildMemberAsync(ctx.Guild.Id, userId, reason: reason);
        await ctx.RespondAsync(new CreateMessageRequest
        {
            Content = $"Member {userId} has been kicked. Reason: {reason}",
        });
        _logger.LogInformation("User {UserId} kicked by {Moderator}",
            userId, ctx.Author.Username);
    }

    [Command("ban")]
    [Description("Permanently ban a member.")]
    public async Task BanAsync(CommandContext ctx, ulong userId,
        [Remainder] string reason = "No reason provided")
    {
        await _rest.CreateGuildBanAsync(ctx.Guild.Id, userId,
            deleteMessageDays: 7, reason: reason);
        await ctx.RespondAsync(new CreateMessageRequest
        {
            Content = $"Member {userId} has been banned.",
        });
    }

    [Command("purge")]
    [Description("Delete the last N messages (2-100).")]
    public async Task PurgeAsync(CommandContext ctx, int count)
    {
        count = Math.Clamp(count, 2, 100);
        var messages = await _rest.GetChannelMessagesAsync(ctx.Channel.Id, limit: count);
        var ids = messages.Select(m => m.Id).ToList();
        await _rest.BulkDeleteMessagesAsync(ctx.Channel.Id, ids);
        await ctx.RespondAsync(new() { Content = $"Deleted {ids.Count} messages." });
    }
}

CommandContext Properties

Every command method receives a CommandContext as its first parameter, providing access to the invoking context and the client.

PropertyTypeDescription
GuildGuildGuild the command was invoked in
ChannelChannelChannel the command was invoked in
AuthorUserUser who sent the triggering message
MessageMessageThe raw message that triggered command parsing
ClientDiscordClientThe bot client instance

Command Attributes

AttributeTargetDescription
[Command(name)]MethodRegisters the method as a command. The name is matched case-insensitively after the prefix.
[Description(text)]Method or ParameterHuman-readable description exposed in help output and error messages.
[Remainder]string ParameterCollects all remaining space-separated tokens into a single string argument.
[Aliases(names)]MethodAdditional command names that invoke the same handler.

Register the extension in your DI setup, then resolve and register modules:

// In service registration — call AddCommands() after AddPawSharp()
services
    .AddSingleton(options)
    .AddPawSharp()
    .AddCommands(new CommandsConfiguration { Prefix = "!" });

// After BuildServiceProvider(), wire up modules
var commands = client.GetExtension<CommandsExtension>();
await commands.RegisterModuleAsync<ModerationCommands>();
await commands.RegisterModuleAsync<GeneralCommands>();

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    if (!msg.Author.IsBot && msg.Content.StartsWith("!"))
        await commands.ProcessCommandAsync(msg.Content, msg, prefix: "!");
});

Slash Commands

Register a global slash command once at startup. Global commands are available in every server and direct message.

var appId = client.CurrentUser.Id;

await client.Rest.CreateGlobalApplicationCommandAsync(appId,
    new CreateApplicationCommandRequest
    {
        Name        = "ping",
        Description = "Check if the bot is responding.",
        Type        = ApplicationCommandType.ChatInput,
    });

// A command with an option
await client.Rest.CreateGlobalApplicationCommandAsync(appId,
    new CreateApplicationCommandRequest
    {
        Name        = "echo",
        Description = "Repeat some text back.",
        Type        = ApplicationCommandType.ChatInput,
        Options = new List<ApplicationCommandOption>
        {
            new()
            {
                Name        = "text",
                Description = "The text to repeat.",
                Type        = ApplicationCommandOptionType.String,
                Required    = true,
            },
        },
    });

Handle interactions from the gateway:

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<InteractionCreateEvent>(async interaction =>
{
    if (interaction.Type != InteractionType.ApplicationCommand)
        return;

    switch (interaction.Data?.Name)
    {
        case "ping":
            await client.Rest.CreateInteractionResponseAsync(
                interaction.Id,
                interaction.Token,
                new InteractionResponse
                {
                    Type = InteractionResponseType.ChannelMessageWithSource,
                    Data = new InteractionCallbackData { Content = "Pong!" },
                });
            break;

        case "echo":
            var text = interaction.Data?.Options
                ?.FirstOrDefault(o => o.Name == "text")?.Value?.ToString()
                ?? "(nothing)";
            await client.Rest.CreateInteractionResponseAsync(
                interaction.Id,
                interaction.Token,
                new InteractionResponse
                {
                    Type = InteractionResponseType.ChannelMessageWithSource,
                    Data = new InteractionCallbackData { Content = text },
                });
            break;
    }
});

Deferred Responses

If your handler needs more than three seconds, defer the response to avoid a timeout. Discord will show a "Bot is thinking…" indicator while you work.

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<InteractionCreateEvent>(async interaction =>
{
    // Immediately acknowledge - shows "Bot is thinking..."
    await client.Rest.CreateInteractionResponseAsync(
        interaction.Id,
        interaction.Token,
        new InteractionResponse
        {
            Type = InteractionResponseType.DeferredChannelMessageWithSource,
        });

    // Do slow work (database query, external API call, etc.)
    var result = await SlowOperationAsync();

    // Edit the deferred message with the final result
    await client.Rest.EditOriginalInteractionResponseAsync(
        interaction.ApplicationId,
        interaction.Token,
        new EditWebhookMessageRequest { Content = result }
    );
});

sections.title: Caching
sections.content:
How Automatic Caching Works

When PawSharp connects to the gateway, the built-in CacheManager subscribes to entity lifecycle events. Guilds, channels, users, members, messages, and roles are stored and kept up to date without any extra code on your part.

var cache = client.Cache;

// Retrieve from cache (synchronous, sub-millisecond)
var guild   = cache.GetGuild(guildId);
var channel = cache.GetChannel(channelId);
var user    = cache.GetUser(userId);
var message = cache.GetMessage(messageId);

// Collections
var guilds   = cache.GetAllGuilds();
var channels = cache.GetGuildChannels(guildId);
var members  = cache.GetGuildMembers(guildId);
var messages = cache.GetChannelMessages(channelId, limit: 100);

// Statistics
var stats    = cache.GetCacheStats();
var memoryMB = cache.GetMemoryUsage() / 1024.0 / 1024.0;
Console.WriteLine($"Guilds: {stats.GuildCount}, Messages: {stats.MessageCount}");
Console.WriteLine($"Memory: {memoryMB:F1} MB");

In-Memory Cache Limits

LimitDefaultNotes
Max entries (total)10,000Configurable via CacheSettings
Max per entity type5,000Individually bounded per type
Eviction policyFIFOOldest entry removed when limit reached

The in-memory cache is not shared between processes, is cleared on restart, and is bounded by available RAM. It works well for single-instance bots under ~2,500 guilds.

Redis Distributed Cache

Replace the default provider with Redis when running multiple shards across separate processes or deploying to a cluster.

// Simple connection
services.AddSingleton<IEntityCache>(
    new RedisCacheProvider("localhost:6379")
);
services.AddPawSharp();

// With authentication and timeouts
var redisOptions = Options.Create(new RedisCacheOptions
{
    ConnectionString = "redis.example.com:6379",
    Password         = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDIS_PASSWORD"),
    Database         = 0,
    DefaultExpiry    = TimeSpan.FromHours(24),
    ConnectTimeout   = 5_000,
    SyncTimeout      = 2_000,
    ConnectRetry     = 3,
});

services.AddSingleton<IEntityCache>(
    new RedisCacheProvider(redisOptions)
);

// High-availability with multiple nodes
services.AddSingleton<IEntityCache>(
    new RedisCacheProvider("node1:6379,node2:6379,node3:6379")
);
i
When to migrate to Redis For bots running a single process with fewer than ~2,500 guilds the in-memory provider is sufficient. Switch to Redis when you add sharding, deploy multiple bot instances, or need the cache to survive process restarts.

Cache Strategies

Event-driven (default): The CacheManager automatically keeps every entity up to date by handling gateway events. Recommended for nearly all bots.

Lazy loading with fallback: Check the cache first and fall back to REST only on a miss.

// Cache-first helper
public async Task<Guild?> GetGuildAsync(ulong guildId)
{
    var cached = client.Cache.GetGuild(guildId);
    if (cached != null)
        return cached;   // Cache hit - instant

    // Cache miss - fetch from Discord and store
    var guild = await client.Rest.GetGuildAsync(guildId);
    if (guild != null)
        client.Cache.CacheGuild(guild);

    return guild;
}

Selective caching: For bots with very high message volume, only cache messages from specific guilds.

private readonly HashSet<ulong> _priorityGuilds = new() { guildId1, guildId2 };

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(msg =>
{
    if (msg.GuildId.HasValue && _priorityGuilds.Contains(msg.GuildId.Value))
        client.Cache.CacheMessage(msg);

    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

Cache warm-up: Preload frequently accessed data immediately after the bot connects.

client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(async _ =>
{
    var guilds = await client.Rest.GetCurrentUserGuildsAsync(limit: 200);
    foreach (var guild in guilds)
    {
        client.Cache.CacheGuild(guild);
        await Task.Delay(5);   // Respect rate limits during bulk seeding
    }
    Console.WriteLine($"Cache warm-up complete: {guilds.Count} guilds loaded.");
});

Cache Invalidation

Subscribe to update and delete events to keep the cache accurate when entities change.

dispatcher.On<GuildUpdateEvent>(e =>
{
    client.Cache.CacheGuild(e.Guild);   // Overwrites stale entry
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

dispatcher.On<GuildDeleteEvent>(e =>
{
    client.Cache.RemoveGuild(e.Id);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

dispatcher.On<ChannelUpdateEvent>(e =>
{
    client.Cache.CacheChannel(e.Channel);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

Cache Health Monitoring

public class CacheMonitor : IDisposable
{
    private readonly IEntityCache _cache;
    private readonly ILogger<CacheMonitor> _logger;
    private Timer? _timer;

    public CacheMonitor(IEntityCache cache, ILogger<CacheMonitor> logger)
    {
        _cache  = cache;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public void Start(TimeSpan interval) =>
        _timer = new Timer(Log, null, interval, interval);

    private void Log(object? _)
    {
        var stats    = _cache.GetCacheStats();
        var memoryMB = _cache.GetMemoryUsage() / 1_048_576.0;

        _logger.LogInformation(
            "Cache: {Total} entities, {Memory:F1} MB - " +
            "guilds={Guilds}, channels={Channels}, messages={Messages}, users={Users}",
            _cache.GetEntityCount(), memoryMB,
            stats.GuildCount, stats.ChannelCount, stats.MessageCount, stats.UserCount
        );
    }

    public void Dispose() => _timer?.Dispose();
}

Multi-Instance Sharding with Redis

When running multiple bot processes each owning a different shard range, point all instances at the same Redis server. Cache sharing is automatic.

// Each process sets its own shard range
var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    Token       = token,
    TotalShards = 12,
    ShardId     = int.Parse(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SHARD_ID")!),
    Shards      = ShardingStrategy.Manual,
};

// All instances share the same cache
services.AddSingleton<IEntityCache>(
    new RedisCacheProvider(Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("REDIS_URL")!)
);
services.AddPawSharp();

sections.title: Common Patterns
sections.content:
Flexible Command Router

A dictionary-based router gives you full control over argument parsing without the command framework.

public class CommandRouter
{
    private readonly IDiscordRestClient _rest;
    private readonly ILogger<CommandRouter> _logger;
    private readonly Dictionary<string, Func<MessageCreateEvent, string[], Task>> _commands = new();

    public CommandRouter(IDiscordRestClient rest, ILogger<CommandRouter> logger)
    {
        _rest   = rest;
        _logger = logger;
    }

    public void Register(string name, Func<MessageCreateEvent, string[], Task> handler)
        => _commands[name.ToLower()] = handler;

    public async Task HandleAsync(MessageCreateEvent msg)
    {
        if (msg.Author.IsBot || !msg.Content.StartsWith("!"))
            return;

        var parts   = msg.Content.Split(' ', StringSplitOptions.RemoveEmptyEntries);
        var command = parts[0][1..].ToLower();
        var args    = parts.Skip(1).ToArray();

        if (!_commands.TryGetValue(command, out var handler))
            return;

        try
        {
            await handler(msg, args);
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            _logger.LogError(ex, "Error executing command: {Command}", command);
            await _rest.CreateMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, new()
            {
                Content = $"Command failed: {ex.Message}",
            });
        }
    }
}

// Usage
var router = new CommandRouter(rest, logger);

router.Register("ping", (msg, _) => rest.CreateMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, new()
{
    Content = "Pong!",
}));

router.Register("echo", (msg, args) => rest.CreateMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, new()
{
    Content = args.Length > 0 ? string.Join(" ", args) : "Usage: !echo <text>",
}));

dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(router.HandleAsync);

Per-User Command Cooldowns

public class CooldownManager
{
    private readonly Dictionary<ulong, DateTime> _lastUsed = new();
    private readonly TimeSpan _cooldown;

    public CooldownManager(TimeSpan cooldown) => _cooldown = cooldown;

    public bool TryUse(ulong userId, out TimeSpan remaining)
    {
        if (_lastUsed.TryGetValue(userId, out var last))
        {
            remaining = _cooldown - (DateTime.UtcNow - last);
            if (remaining > TimeSpan.Zero)
                return false;
        }

        _lastUsed[userId] = DateTime.UtcNow;
        remaining         = TimeSpan.Zero;
        return true;
    }
}

// Usage in an event handler
var cooldown = new CooldownManager(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(5));

dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    if (!msg.Content.StartsWith("!")) return;

    if (!cooldown.TryUse(msg.Author.Id, out var remaining))
    {
        await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, new()
        {
            Content = $"Please wait {remaining.TotalSeconds:F1} seconds.",
        });
        return;
    }

    // Process command normally
});

Auto-Moderation

public class AutoModerator
{
    private readonly IDiscordRestClient _rest;
    private readonly ILogger<AutoModerator> _logger;

    // Detects repeated characters such as "aaaaaaaaaa"
    private static readonly Regex SpamPattern =
        new(@"(.)\1{10,}", RegexOptions.Compiled);

    public async Task InspectAsync(MessageCreateEvent msg)
    {
        if (msg.Author.IsBot) return;

        if (SpamPattern.IsMatch(msg.Content))
        {
            await _rest.DeleteMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, msg.Id);
            await WarnAsync(msg.ChannelId, msg.Author.Id, "Repeated character spam.");
            return;
        }

        var capsRatio = GetCapsRatio(msg.Content);
        if (msg.Content.Length > 10 && capsRatio > 0.8)
        {
            await _rest.DeleteMessageAsync(msg.ChannelId, msg.Id);
            await WarnAsync(msg.ChannelId, msg.Author.Id, "Excessive caps.");
        }
    }

    private static double GetCapsRatio(string text)
    {
        var letters = text.Where(char.IsLetter).ToList();
        return letters.Count == 0 ? 0 : letters.Count(char.IsUpper) / (double)letters.Count;
    }

    private async Task WarnAsync(ulong channelId, ulong userId, string reason)
    {
        _logger.LogWarning("Auto-mod: user {UserId} - {Reason}", userId, reason);
        await _rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, new()
        {
            Content = $"<@{userId}> - {reason}",
        });
    }
}

dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(autoMod.InspectAsync);

Moderation Actions with Audit Logging

public class ModerationService
{
    private readonly IDiscordRestClient _rest;
    private readonly ulong _modLogChannelId;

    public async Task KickAsync(ulong guildId, ulong targetId, string reason)
    {
        await _rest.RemoveGuildMemberAsync(guildId, targetId, reason: reason);
        await LogAsync("Kick", guildId, targetId, reason);
    }

    public async Task BanAsync(ulong guildId, ulong targetId, string reason, int deleteDays = 0)
    {
        await _rest.CreateGuildBanAsync(guildId, targetId, deleteDays, reason: reason);
        await LogAsync("Ban", guildId, targetId, reason);
    }

    private async Task LogAsync(string action, ulong guildId, ulong targetId, string reason)
    {
        var embed = new Embed
        {
            Title  = $"Moderation - {action}",
            Color  = 0xE74C3C,
            Fields = new List<EmbedField>
            {
                new() { Name = "Target", Value = $"<@{targetId}>",       Inline = true  },
                new() { Name = "Action", Value = action,                   Inline = true  },
                new() { Name = "Reason", Value = reason ?? "Not provided", Inline = false },
            },
            Timestamp = DateTime.UtcNow,
        };

        await _rest.CreateMessageAsync(_modLogChannelId, new()
        {
            Embeds = new List<Embed> { embed },
        });
    }
}

Welcome Message on Member Join

// Replace with your server's default member role ID (0 = no default role assigned)
ulong defaultRoleId = 0;

dispatcher.On<GuildMemberAddEvent>(async member =>
{
    var guild = client.Cache.GetGuild(member.GuildId)
             ?? await client.Rest.GetGuildAsync(member.GuildId);

    if (guild == null) return;

    // Resolve the welcome channel from cache or REST
    var channels = client.Cache.GetGuildChannels(member.GuildId)
                ?? await client.Rest.GetGuildChannelsAsync(member.GuildId);

    var welcomeChannel = channels
        ?.FirstOrDefault(c => c.Name == "welcome" && c.Type == ChannelType.GuildText);

    if (welcomeChannel == null) return;

    await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(welcomeChannel.Id, new CreateMessageRequest
    {
        Content = $"<@{member.User.Id}> just joined the server.",
        Embeds  = new List<Embed>
        {
            new()
            {
                Title       = $"Welcome, {member.User.Username}!",
                Description = $"You are member #{guild.MemberCount}.",
                Color       = 0x2ECC71,
                Timestamp   = DateTime.UtcNow,
            },
        },
    });

    if (defaultRoleId != 0)
        await client.Rest.AddGuildMemberRoleAsync(member.GuildId, member.User.Id, defaultRoleId);
});

sections.title: Error Handling
sections.content:
Exception Types

ExceptionWhen thrownKey Properties
ValidationExceptionInvalid input before the request is sentMessage
RateLimitExceptionDiscord returned HTTP 429RetryAfter (TimeSpan)
DiscordApiExceptionDiscord returned a non-2xx responseStatusCode, ErrorCode
GatewayExceptionWebSocket connection or protocol errorCloseCode

Catching REST Errors

public async Task SafeSendAsync(ulong channelId, CreateMessageRequest request)
{
    try
    {
        await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
    }
    catch (ValidationException ex)
    {
        // Input was invalid before reaching Discord - fix the request
        _logger.LogWarning("Validation failed: {Message}", ex.Message);
    }
    catch (RateLimitException ex)
    {
        // Back off and retry once
        _logger.LogWarning("Rate limited - retrying after {Ms} ms",
            ex.RetryAfter.TotalMilliseconds);
        await Task.Delay(ex.RetryAfter);
        await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
    }
    catch (DiscordApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 403)
    {
        // Missing Permissions - do not retry
        _logger.LogError("Permission denied posting to channel {ChannelId}", channelId);
    }
    catch (DiscordApiException ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError("Discord API error ({Code}): {Message}",
            ex.StatusCode, ex.Message);
    }
}

Global Error Middleware

Exceptions thrown inside event handlers are silently swallowed by default. Register this middleware before any event subscriptions.

dispatcher.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    try
    {
        await next();
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Uncaught exception in event handler: {EventType}",
            ctx.GetType().Name);
    }
});

// Individual handlers can also have their own try/catch
dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    try
    {
        await ProcessMessageAsync(msg);
    }
    catch (RateLimitException ex)
    {
        await Task.Delay(ex.RetryAfter);
        await ProcessMessageAsync(msg);   // Single retry
    }
    catch (DiscordApiException ex) when (ex.StatusCode == 404)
    {
        // Channel or message was deleted - nothing to do
    }
});

Rate-Limit-Safe Request Queue

public class RequestQueue
{
    private readonly SemaphoreSlim _semaphore = new(5, 5);  // Max 5 concurrent
    private readonly IDiscordRestClient _rest;

    public RequestQueue(IDiscordRestClient rest) => _rest = rest;

    public async Task<Message?> SendMessageAsync(
        ulong channelId, CreateMessageRequest request)
    {
        await _semaphore.WaitAsync();
        try
        {
            return await _rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
        }
        catch (RateLimitException ex)
        {
            await Task.Delay(ex.RetryAfter);
            return await _rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
        }
        finally
        {
            _semaphore.Release();
        }
    }
}

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.content:
Invalid Token

The most common cause is whitespace or a typo when reading the token from the environment.

// Trim whitespace that may have been added by the shell
var token = (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DISCORD_TOKEN") ?? "")
    .Trim();

if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("DISCORD_TOKEN is not set.");

var options = new PawSharpOptions { Token = token };

Other causes:

  • Using a user token instead of a bot token — bot tokens start with Bot
  • Token was regenerated in the Developer Portal — the old token is immediately invalidated
  • Token was inadvertently committed to version control and Discord auto-revoked it

Events Not Firing

// Cause 1: Required intent not requested
var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    Intents = GatewayIntents.AllUnprivileged | GatewayIntents.MessageContent,
    //                                         ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
    // Without MessageContent, msg.Content will be an empty string
};

// Cause 2: Privileged intent not enabled in the Developer Portal
// Fix: Enable under Bot -> Privileged Gateway Intents

// Cause 3: Handler throws silently before doing anything observable
// Fix: Add global error-handling middleware (see Error Handling section)

// Cause 4: Subscribing after ConnectAsync may miss early events
// Always subscribe BEFORE calling ConnectAsync()
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(handler);
await client.ConnectAsync();   // Subscribe first, then connect

Gateway Connection Problems

// Monitor session events to isolate the problem
dispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(_ =>
{
    Console.WriteLine("Session established.");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

dispatcher.On<ResumedEvent>(_ =>
{
    Console.WriteLine("Session resumed after reconnect.");
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// Test basic connectivity
var http     = new HttpClient();
var response = await http.GetAsync("https://discord.com/api/v10/gateway");
Console.WriteLine($"Gateway reachable: {response.IsSuccessStatusCode}");

// Enable verbose logging - shows full WebSocket handshake
services.AddLogging(b => b
    .AddConsole()
    .SetMinimumLevel(LogLevel.Debug));

Rate Limit Errors (HTTP 429)

try
{
    await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
}
catch (RateLimitException ex)
{
    Console.WriteLine($"Rate limited - retry after {ex.RetryAfter.TotalMilliseconds} ms");
    await Task.Delay(ex.RetryAfter);
    await client.Rest.CreateMessageAsync(channelId, request);
}

// For bulk operations, space out requests to avoid bursting
foreach (var name in roleNames)
{
    await client.Rest.CreateGuildRoleAsync(guildId, new CreateRoleRequest { Name = name });
    await Task.Delay(100);   // 100 ms gap reduces burst traffic
}

Missing Permissions (HTTP 403)

// Discord enforces role hierarchy:
// You can only modify members whose highest role is below your bot's highest role.

var bot    = await client.Rest.GetGuildMemberAsync(guildId, client.CurrentUser.Id);
var target = await client.Rest.GetGuildMemberAsync(guildId, targetUserId);
var roles  = await client.Rest.GetGuildRolesAsync(guildId);

var botTop = bot.RoleIds
    .Select(id => roles.First(r => r.Id == id))
    .Max(r => r.Position);

var targetTop = target.RoleIds
    .Select(id => roles.First(r => r.Id == id))
    .Max(r => r.Position);

if (botTop > targetTop)
    await client.Rest.RemoveGuildMemberAsync(guildId, targetUserId);
else
    Console.WriteLine("Cannot act: target's role is equal to or above the bot's.");

High Memory Usage

// Reduce cache size via CacheSettings
var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    CacheSettings = new CacheSettings
    {
        MaxCachedMessages = 5_000,                      // Reduce from default 10,000
        MessageCacheTTL   = TimeSpan.FromMinutes(30),   // Expire entries sooner
    },
};

// Monitor working set at runtime
var process  = System.Diagnostics.Process.GetCurrentProcess();
var memoryMB = process.WorkingSet64 / 1_048_576.0;
Console.WriteLine($"Process memory: {memoryMB:F0} MB");

// For large-scale deployments, switch to Redis which handles eviction externally
services.AddSingleton<IEntityCache>(new RedisCacheProvider(redisUrl));

Stale Cache Data

// Subscribe to update events to keep the cache current
dispatcher.On<GuildUpdateEvent>(e =>
{
    client.Cache.CacheGuild(e.Guild);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

dispatcher.On<ChannelDeleteEvent>(e =>
{
    client.Cache.RemoveChannel(e.Id);
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

// For Redis: ensure the StackExchange.Redis connection string is correct
// Connection refused usually means the Redis server is not running
// or the wrong host/port is specified.

Collecting Debug Information

// Include this in bug reports
Console.WriteLine(typeof(DiscordClient).Assembly.GetName().Version);
Console.WriteLine(System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation.FrameworkDescription);
Console.WriteLine(System.Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation.OSDescription);
Console.WriteLine($"Is connected: {client.Gateway.IsConnected}");

Open an issue at github.com/M1tsumi/PawSharp with a minimal reproducible example, the full exception and stack trace, and the debug output above.

sections.title: Best Practices
sections.content:
Never Hard-Code Tokens

// Correct: read from the environment and trim whitespace
var token = (Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("DISCORD_TOKEN") ?? "")
    .Trim();
if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(token))
    throw new InvalidOperationException("DISCORD_TOKEN is not set.");

// Avoid: credentials in source code get committed to version control
var options = new PawSharpOptions { Token = "MzI4ODk1NzQ..." };   // BAD

Subscribe to Events Before Connecting

// Correct: subscribe first, then connect
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(handler);
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(handler);
await client.ConnectAsync();

// Incorrect: early events may fire before your handler is registered
await client.ConnectAsync();
client.Gateway.EventDispatcher.On<ReadyEvent>(handler);   // May have already fired

Keep Event Handlers Non-Blocking

// Correct: async throughout
dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(async msg =>
{
    var channel = await client.Rest.GetChannelAsync(msg.ChannelId);
    Console.WriteLine($"#{channel?.Name}: {msg.Content}");
});

// Avoid: .Result blocks the thread and can cause deadlocks
dispatcher.On<MessageCreateEvent>(msg =>
{
    var channel = client.Rest.GetChannelAsync(msg.ChannelId).Result;   // BAD
    return Task.CompletedTask;
});

Use a Global Error Middleware

// Register before any On<> subscriptions
dispatcher.Use(async (ctx, next) =>
{
    try
    {
        await next();
    }
    catch (Exception ex)
    {
        _logger.LogError(ex, "Unhandled exception in {EventType}",
            ctx.GetType().Name);
    }
});

Graceful Shutdown

using var cts = new CancellationTokenSource();

Console.CancelKeyPress += async (_, e) =>
{
    e.Cancel = true;
    Console.WriteLine("Received shutdown signal. Disconnecting...");
    await client.DisconnectAsync();
    cts.Cancel();
};

await client.ConnectAsync();
await Task.Delay(Timeout.Infinite, cts.Token);
Console.WriteLine("Shutdown complete.");

Logging Setup

// Development: verbose output
services.AddLogging(b => b
    .AddConsole()
    .SetMinimumLevel(LogLevel.Debug));

// Production: information and above only
services.AddLogging(b => b
    .AddConsole()
    .SetMinimumLevel(LogLevel.Information));

Enable Auto-Sharding Early

// ShardingStrategy.Auto is a no-op for small bots.
// Enable it before you need it to avoid a migration at 2,500 guilds.

var options = new PawSharpOptions
{
    Token  = token,
    Shards = ShardingStrategy.Auto,
};

var shardManager = provider.GetRequiredService<ShardManager>();
await shardManager.ConnectAllAsync();
